title: Banderling Conquest Dungeon
subtitle: Eastham Warden quest: the Banderling Mace Shaft (one part of the mace)
steps: In the Facility Hub, talk to the Warden for the Mace of the Explorer.
Take the level 25 portal to the Banderling Conquest Dungeon and take the Banderling Mace Shaft.
Return to the hub and take the Mosswart Maze portal for the Mace Head.
Combine both parts into the Banderling Ceremonial Weapon.
Take it to Olivier Rognath in the middle of Eastham.
Bring the Mace of the Explorer he gives you back to the Warden.

notes.title: Quest item
notes.body: The Mace Shaft is placed in the data. A battered leather journal is also in here.

notes.title: Best damage
notes.body: Banderlings take 0.5 bludgeon, 0.65 pierce and acid. Raiders and Guards are level 15, the Chief level 20.

notes.title: Other part
notes.body: The Mace Head is in the Mosswart Maze.
